jobs.title: NetSuite Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

**About the Team**


Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud\-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data\-driven decision\-making.


Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end\-to\-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long\-term growth.

**About the Role**


Crowe seeks a **NetSuite Implementation Manager** to lead ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role oversees project delivery, manages client relationships, and leads consulting teams throughout implementation engagements. You will guide the full implementation lifecycle including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.


The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with NetSuite functional knowledge and supply chain expertise. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, and order management processes is highly valued.


This role requires managing multiple projects while mentoring consultants and ensuring strong client outcomes. You will partner with client leaders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams. Together, you will design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency and inventory visibility.


This position is comparable to roles such as NetSuite Project Manager or NetSuite ERP Consulting Manager.

**Core Skills**


NetSuite ERP, ERP Implementation, NetSuite Financials, Manufacturing ERP, Supply Chain ERP, SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite Advanced Manufacturing, NetSuite Advanced Inventory, NetSuite Demand Planning, NetSuite Order Management, NetSuite WMS, ERP Consulting, Financial Systems Implementation, NetSuite Integrations, Business Process Transformation, ERP Project Management

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead NetSuite ERP implementations in several industries (with an emphasis on Manufacturing and Distribution) from discovery through post\-go\-live support.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring successful client outcomes.
* Gather and document business requirements related business processes.
* Facilitate requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and user acceptance testing sessions.
* Configure NetSuite modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and multi\-entity financial consolidations.
* Implement operational modules including Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Demand Planning, and Manufacturing; with working knowledge of project\-based or subscription billing for services clients.
* Support manufacturing processes including bill of materials, work orders, production planning, and shop floor operations.
* Configure workflows and reporting using SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, and other NetSuite platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with technical teams implementing integrations with WMS, ecommerce, logistics, and supply chain systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process optimization and automation.
* Mentor consultants and analysts while supporting knowledge sharing across implementation teams.
* Ensure successful client transition to post\-implementation support or managed services tea

jobs.title: Project Manager - Interior Designer
jobs.description:
Overview::

Make a lasting impact through design!
Location: **San Francisco, CA**  

At HGA, we believe design has the power to create meaningful change. We are seeking an experienced **Project Manager** to join our San Francisco Interior Design practice, where you'll collaborate with award\-winning designers, architects, and thought leaders to deliver innovative environments that inspire discovery, connection, and performance.  

This is an opportunity to lead transformative projects for clients across various markets, combining strategic thinking, design excellence, sustainability, and research\-driven solutions to create spaces that have a lasting impact.  

As a Project Manager, you will play a key leadership role in guiding projects from concept through completion while serving as a trusted advisor to clients and project teams.  

You will:* Lead multidisciplinary project teams through all phases of design and delivery.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and client expectations.
* Foster collaboration among designers, architects, consultants, and stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted strategic partner.
* Support the pursuit of design excellence while ensuring project performance and quality.
* Contribute to the growth of our Science \& Technology practice through exceptional service and leadership.
 **In this role you will:**  

* Collaborate with industry professionals in evaluation of project requirements and help to negotiate an acceptable owner\-architect agreement including the fee and time schedule.
* Demonstrate task\-focused mastery of project scope, profitability, schedule and budget.
* Complete projects on schedule, within budget and with maximum client satisfaction.
* Negotiate critical issues with top\-level architects, engineers and officials of other organizations and firms.
* Utilize experience and technical knowledge and monitor quality of the construction documents keeping in mind schedules/budgets and provide coaching/communication as appropriate with team leaders and/or team members who are responsible for workflow/timelines, etc.
* Develop discipline cost and work\-hour budgets for each project and monitor project costs, completion status against budget schedules/timelines.
* Oversee all correspondence and pertinent documents, making sure they are accurate, sign or obtain signatures and seek legal counsel as appropriate.
* Coordinate review and evaluation of contractor bids and work with Principal so that award recommendation can be submitted to owner.
* Provide day\-to\-day leadership in the absence of and as delegated by the Principal, Practice Group Leader and/or Department Leader keeping lines of communication open with all office management leaders and assist with preparation of client billings prior to submittal for signature.
* Collaborate with the senior leadership as requested in the marketing of projects including development of proposals and participation in client interviews.
* Set an example for team effort through the spirit of cooperation and collaboration while directing, organizing, coaching and mentoring junior staff.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

 **What you will need to have:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design or related field from an accredited program.
* 7 to 10 years of professional experience in interior design, including prior Project Management experience.
* NCIDQ or CID accreditation strongly preferred.
* Proven leadership and project management skills with a track record of successfully delivering projects.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both team members and clients.
* Ability to oversee and be responsible for all aspects of project delivery, ensuring timely and quality results.
* Proficiency in Revit, SketchUp, and other industry\-standard software, alongside expertise in Microsoft Office products.

 **Salary Information:**  

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short\- and long\-term disability programs. Salary Range: $115,000 to $132,200 **depending on qualifications and experience**. **Additional Information:**  

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work\-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award\-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.  

Learn more about us **here****.** **Application Requirements \& Instructions**  

Please submit resume and portfolio for consideration.

jobs.title: Technology Vendor Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 174368
  
  

**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Technology \& Security
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  

Department Overview
  
The Office of the CIO (OCIO) represents the cross\-functional IT Management capabilities that enable running the business of IT. The OCIO focuses on supporting IT's operation model by ensuring a consistent, transparent, and efficient approach to the way the IT organization delivers value to its partners. The core of the OCIO consists of four areas essential to the long\-term success of IT: Contract Management, Business Operations, Program Management Office, and Investment Management.
  
  

Position Summary
  
The Technology Vendor Manager serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor in managing the organization’s technology vendor ecosystem. This role bridges business strategy, IT leadership, and vendor relationships to ensure technology investments deliver maximum value, are cost\-optimized, and align with long\-term capital and operating plans.
  
  

The Technology Vendor Manager has a genuine passion for operational excellence and vendor management, possesses robust communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrates high analytical capabilities, is vendor\-focused, team\-oriented and highly capable of working independently and cross functionally to meet PG\&E operational and business objectives.
  
  

The Technology Vendor Manager will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Operations, Architecture, and Sourcing, to define vendor\-specific requirements, and oversee performance through KPIs and SLAs. Success in this role requires agility in communication, with the ability to engage confidently with executives while working closely with technical teams and individual contributors.
  
  

The Technology Vendor Manager plays a critical role in aligning vendor strategy with the organization’s technology and business objectives. This position works across operations, enterprise architecture, sourcing, and IT leadership to manage vendor and support program reporting to executives to enable strategic decision\-making. The role ensures technology purchases are optimized, integrated, and aligned with the company’s multi\-year capital and expense investment plans.
  
  

PG\&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint $85,000 \- $106,000\. The final decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
  

**Bay Area Min:** $ 85,000
  
**Bay Area Max:** $ 127,000
  
  

Job Responsibilities Through strong partnerships with internal stakeholders – including sourcing, IT, architecture, finance, legal and business teams – ensures vendor relationships contribute measurable results to PG\&E performance objectives Partner with Operations, Architecture, IT Leadership, and other stakeholders to align and document vendor capabilities Manage the full lifecycle of vendor relationships, including onboarding, governance, performance reviews, and contract compliance. As a senior individual contributor within the Vendor Management function, this role ensures suppliers deliver consistently against contractual commitment, service level agreements, and compliance requirements while driving operational excellence and innovation Manage vendor relationships across the lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology roadmap
  
  

**Other duties include:** Build strong, value\-driven relationships with key suppliers to drive: Performance accountability Innovation and continuous improvement Ensure alignment between vendor capabilities and Digital strategy and priorities Cost Optimization Identify and support execution of cost optimization opportunities across all strategic vendor engagements Partner with Supply Chain to institutionalize end\-to\-end visibility into vendor spend, including, Professional services and staff augmentation, SaaS and subscription costs Deliver standardized reporting and dashboards to provide vendor\-level spend insights Define and track clear savings targets and value realization metrics
  
  

Qualifications
  
**Minimum:** Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience 3 years job\-related experience in IT vendor management, sourcing, or technology strategy
  
  

**Desired:** Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline Professional certifications such as Certified Professional in Supplier Management (CPSM), Certified Technology Procurement Professional (CTPP), or ITIL certification Experience managing vendors within large, complex enterprises and multi\-year investment planning cycles Experience with ERP, vendor management or procurement tools (e.g., SAP Ariba, Coupa, ServiceNow, GEP) Knowledge of regulatory, compliance, and risk management considerations in IT vendor contracts Strong track record of driving innovation and value creation through vendor partnerships
  
  

**Other Skills:** Skilled in project management, time management, and reporting to executives Vendor Management: Expertise in managing and optimizing relationships with Tier\-1 suppliers Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop supplier strategies that align with PG\&E objectives and enhance supplier relations Project Management: Proficiency in managing large scale projects, including implementation of new technologies and process improvements Cost Optimization: Partner with Sourcing to identify levers to secure favorable terms and manage supplier contract cost

jobs.title: Account Manager - Security
jobs.description:
Account Manager \- Security **Job overview**


The Account Manager owns client satisfaction, contract delivery, and team performance for assigned accounts. You’ll lead site leadership and officer teams, ensure post orders are executed flawlessly, manage scheduling and overtime, and drive KPI results (safety, service quality, and attrition). This role blends people leadership, client relationship management, and disciplined operations.

 ***Please note: This position is not eligible for remote work. Employees must work onsite Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.***

 **Responsibilities and Duties**

* Client Success \& Relationship Management
* Serve as the primary point of contact; run weekly/biweekly client check\-ins and QBRs.
* Translate the Statement of Work (SOW) into daily execution; maintain current post orders and SOPs.
* Proactively resolve service issues and escalations; develop corrective action plans and follow\-through.
* Operational Excellence
* Own scheduling, staffing levels, and overtime control; partner with Recruiting on pipeline health.
* Conduct site inspections, audits, and drills; ensure adherence to SOW, licensing, and training.
* Maintain accurate site documentation (site books, post orders, emergency procedures, equipment logs).
* Team Leadership
* Hire, onboard, coach, and develop Supervisors/Officers; conduct regular performance huddles.
* Enforce policies and standards consistently; recognize and reward strong performance.
* Foster a culture of safety, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
* Compliance \& Risk
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, state/local licensing, and company policy.
* Lead incident response and reporting (near misses, injuries, property damage, workplace violence).
* Partner with the GM/HR on investigations, accommodations, and documentation best practices.

**Qualifications**

* 3\-5\+ years of progressive leadership in contract security, facilities, hospitality, or related operations (account/site management preferred).
* Proven client\-facing experience with strong service recovery and stakeholder management skills.
* Working knowledge of security operations, incident management, and post order development.
* Familiarity with state security guard licensing requirements and training standards.
* Comfortable with scheduling systems such as Winteam and MS Office; data\-driven decision\-making.
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to create concise reports and SOPs.

**Physical/Environmental Requirements**

* Ability to walk/stand for extended periods during site tours/inspections; occasional lifting up to 25 lbs.
* Work may include indoor/outdoor environments and variable weather; occasional evenings/weekends for emergencies or client needs.

**Education \& Licensing**

* High school diploma or GED required;
* Must hold/obtain and maintain any required state/local security licenses and permits for assigned sites.
* A current CPR certification is required; candidates who are not currently certified must successfully obtain certification prior to their first day of training.
* Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record (if role requires driving between sites).

  

CA PPO 120931 \#WER123

  

At Prosegur, we make our world safer by taking care of people and businesses while remaining at the forefront of innovation. Every day, we work to secure what our clients value most, from their families to their assets, from their reputation to their networks, and from their money to their cloud. As the 3rd largest security services provider, our 175k\+ team members in 36 countries combine and adapt global best practices to match the unique nature of each market we serve and partner with Electronic Security, Global Risk Services, CyberSecurity, and Remote Services (iSOC) divisions to create meaningful ‘Hybrid Security' solutions for Prospects.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview::
**Project Coordinator**
Location: **San Francisco, CA**  

HGA is seeking a dynamic and driven **Project Coordinator** to join our San Francisco, CA Interior Design team. We’re looking for someone with exceptional communication, presentation, time‑management, and interpersonal skills—someone who thrives in a collaborative setting and is passionate about elevating design.  

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Interior Designers, Project Architects, and Project Managers to help shape innovative, technically sound design solutions. You’ll contribute to the development of detailed project documentation while upholding our firm’s commitment to design excellence and outstanding client service.### **What You’ll Do:**

* Partner on the development of construction documents and ensure design intent is accurately carried through.
* Translate complex project goals into creative and functional design solutions.
* Collaborate across disciplines to coordinate architectural and engineering systems.
* Participate in client meetings and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Partner to meet critical project milestones and deadlines maintaining a high level of attention to detail and quality.

 **In this role you will:**  

* Develop a thorough understanding of projects’ design philosophy and provide major input in developing a design and building performance strategy, effectively conveying this to assigned team members when appropriate.
* Provide technical design input and support for the development of the entire design concept.
* Coordinate the project’s technical design effort, subsequent detailed design development, project coordination and quality control efforts during all phases of project work, in close collaboration with an Interior Designer, Project Architect, Senior Designer and Project Manager.
* Seek creative and innovative solutions to assigned tasks and develop appropriate research and documents to support these solutions.
* Actively collaborate with and coordinate work of consultants and knowledge resources to ensure the project deliverables are coordinated, integrated and support the design concept and performance goals of the project.
* Contribute to the preparation of design documents and leads the detailed development of construction documents during all project phases, delivering complete, accurate and coordinated project documentation.
* Advance the production of schematic, design development and construction document drawings and specifications in compliance with project scope, schedule, cost and design intent.
* Review and coordinate project documents with relevant Building Codes, City Planning/Zoning ordinances and similar requirements for Authorities Having Jurisdiction.
* Maintain awareness of evolving building technology and systems.
* Review shop drawings, material samples and Construction Documents for conformance with design.
* Perform construction administration duties (e.g., RFI’s, RFP’s, change orders, etc.).
* Maintain contact with clients, consultants and contractors during all project phases, participating in marketing, client and owner presentations as required.

 **What you will need to have:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited Interior Design/Interior Architecture program or related field
* 5 to 7 years of experience working on small\- to large\-scale project types
* Experience with TI and core and shell
* Strong graphic skills
* Revit knowledge and experience required
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp and other industry accepted software as well as expertise with project management software and Microsoft Office Suite products is needed
* Ability to travel to job sites

jobs.title: Account Manager - Customer Growth
jobs.description:
**DealHub.AI** is building the future of agentic revenue technology. Trusted by leading global businesses, we’re redefining what revenue teams can achieve with AI and agentic execution across the deal lifecycle. Our mission is simple: help businesses Own Your Revenue with greater speed, intelligence, and governance.


As a **Strategic Account Manager**, you will be responsible for building and expanding strategic relationships with DealHub’s strategic customers.


Your primary focus will be to establish trusted relationships with C\-level and senior executive stakeholders, understand their strategic business priorities, and position DealHub as a long\-term strategic partner. You will own the executive relationship strategy across a portfolio of strategic accounts, working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and DealHub leadership to deepen customer engagement, identify growth opportunities, and drive retention and expansion.


This is a highly relationship\-driven role. You’ll spend significant time engaging with customer executives, developing multi\-threaded relationships across the organization, creating executive sponsorship, and identifying opportunities where DealHub can deliver additional business value.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the strategic relationship with a portfolio of DealHub’s enterprise customers.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with C\-level and senior executives, and other business leaders.
* Establish strong executive sponsorship for DealHub within strategic customers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business strategy, organizational priorities, challenges, and growth initiatives.
* Position DealHub as a strategic business partner and trusted advisor, rather than simply a technology vendor.
* Build multi\-threaded relationships across customer organizations and reduce dependency on individual contacts.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to develop and execute account growth and expansion strategies.
* Identify commercial opportunities and influence the development of expansion opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Lead executive\-level business reviews and strategic customer meetings.
* Act as a senior escalation point for strategic customers and coordinate with internal leadership to drive resolution of critical issues.
* Work closely with Customer Success to ensure strategic accounts have strong success plans, executive alignment, and clear business outcomes.
* Develop and maintain strategic account plans, including stakeholder maps, executive relationships, business priorities, risks, opportunities, and growth plans.
* Drive customer advocacy, including executive references, case studies, customer events, and customer advisory programs.
* Represent DealHub in executive customer meetings, industry events, and strategic customer forums.
* Track and communicate account health, executive engagement, retention risks, and expansion opportunities to DealHub leadership.

  

Requirements:
  

* 7\+ years of experience in Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, Account Executive, Customer Success, or a similar role within a B2B SaaS company.
* Proven experience managing strategic enterprise accounts and building long\-term customer relationships.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate effectively and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to understand customer strategy, organizational priorities, and business challenges.
* Proven experience identifying and driving expansion and growth opportunities within existing enterprise accounts.
* Experience developing and executing strategic account plans.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to operate strategically while maintaining strong attention to customer and business details.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and executive leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic accounts and priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and highly accountable.
* Familiarity with CPQ, CRM, Billing, or Sales Enablement platforms is a strong advantage.

**Job Description**
-------------------

St. Jude is where those with a passion for making a difference come to break new ground. Located in Memphis, Tennessee, the mission of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital is to advance cures, and means of prevention, for pediatric catastrophic diseases through research and treatment. We are leading the way the world understands, treats and defeats childhood cancer and other life\-threatening diseases.  

  

We are looking for a highly talented Sr. Business Analyst to join our growing clinical research informatics team to support the development, implementation, and support of a robust clinical research data environment. Throughout the institution, across the clinical, research, administrative, and operational domains there are many clinical research customers who need access to accurate and consistently defined data to drive insightful analytics and support the broader research mission of the organization. This Sr. Business Analyst will be responsible for putting a structured program in place to enhance the ability for St. Jude to meet our mission and participate even further in the global research community.**Job Responsibilities:**

* Proactively engage with stakeholders \& vendors to support delivery of solutions in line with business plans.
* Apprise on development and vision of strategies for in partnership with business stakeholders and IT peers.
* Oversee all requirements including new demands as well as escalations for operational requests with assigned departments.
* Lead activities related to education of business teams around strategy, services, and capabilities, as well as IT change management \& communication.
* Inform and implement IT change and communication management plans across assigned departments.
* Develop business cases/proposals for programs and projects based on understanding of departmental roadmap.
* Develop presentation materials, documents, etc. for programs/projects and present materials to stakeholders.
* Assist with project management responsibilities.
* Guide and direct team members around processes/systems/issues related to business aspects as well as services and process capabilities.
* Perform other duties as assigned to meet the goals and objectives of the department and institution.
* Maintains regular and predictable attendance.

**Minimum Education and/or Training:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, business or related field required.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Minimum requirement: 4\+ years of experience in a comparable client\-facing IT role.
* Experience working with structured Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
* Exposure to diverse business ecosystems of moderate complexity in pharma, healthcare, biotech and/or research organization preferred.
* Demonstrated history leading discussions and documenting resulting business and/or technical requirements, user stories and process flows.
* Experience translating business requirements to technical/system requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to work with mid to senior\-level business leaders.

**Licensure, Registration and/or Certification Required by Law:**

* None

**Licensure, Registration and/or Certification Required by SJCRH Only:**

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:** Reporting to the Director of Client Operations, the Client Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring best practice and optimal revenue cycle results for assigned CBO clients, with direct oversight of 8\-12 clients. The Client Operations Manager is accountable to client and employee satisfaction, KPI and other client performance results and collaborating internally and externally to drive revenue cycle and reimbursement initiatives. This role develops an environment and culture that embraces continuous improvement and innovation to ensure best practices are achieved in all areas of the revenue cycle. They will lead a team of A/R Specialists to ensure maximized collectability of services performed. Ensuring that internal policies and practices support the operational quality, efficiency, and compliance of all standard practices. They will coordinate with other cross functional areas that impact or support RCM to ensure appropriate collaboration and system wide efficiency of operations while providing oversight and employee development for direct reports.

  


**Responsibilities:**


* Manages a team of 6\-10 employees who complete the accounts receivable functions resulting in revenue generation.
* Continuously evaluates and is expected to be actively involved in ensuring all revenue cycle operations are well\-managed, delivering excellence in quality standards, consistently meeting the organizations and client expectations.
* Facilitates the identification of issues and solutions by team members related to delays in achieving payment resolution.
* Monitors collection processes to determine cash flow improvement opportunities.
* Manages the aging of accounts receivable by trending and analyzing the A/R, and thorough communication with payers.
* Manage the implementation of key strategies; fostering an environment of accountability to create a high performing team.
* Successfully communicates trends, issues, resolutions as well as proactively communicates opportunities to clients.
* Must become expert on respective clients, regional payer trends and overall client specifics.
* Maintains thorough understanding of health insurance and government programs, when necessary.
* Assist assigned staff in establishing daily/weekly workflows to accomplish KPIs.
* Manage assignments across entire team to meet employee productivity and collection efforts across all client facilities.
* Provides analysis, reporting, and recommendations for revenue performance in key metrics including billing, collection, and posting, such as A/R aging’s, volumes, and trends.
* Conduct routine quality assurance reviews of work completed; initiate coaching measures as needed.
* Evaluate the audit findings, creating and establishing baselines and expectations to measure improvements.
* Leverage audit findings to identify training needs for system education, industry updates and changes in collections processes and protocols.
* Provide training for newly hired and existing employees to generate consistent team output.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Social Science Research
jobs.description:
**Location:** **Remote**
**Employment Type:** **Contract / Project\-Based**
**Anticipated Period:** **October 2026 – September 2027**
**Company:** **The Brandon Green Management Group (BGMG)**
**Project:** **Federal Correctional Officer Retention Analysis**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**


BGMG is seeking a **Project Manager** to support a federal research project focused on correctional officer workforce retention and attrition.  

  

**\*\*This role is pending subject to contract award\*\***


The Project Manager will lead project coordination, schedule management, client communication, risk tracking, and delivery of research products. The role requires prior experience managing social science research projects with overlapping tasks and deadlines.


The Project Manager is designated as **key personnel** and is expected to remain available throughout the 12\-month period of performance.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a fast\-paced quantitative social science research project.
* Coordinate the work of researchers and quantitative analysts.
* Lead project planning, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Support and participate in the project kickoff meeting.
* Maintain the project work plan and detailed project timeline.
* Prepare or oversee biweekly progress reports.
* Prepare agendas and meeting notes for monthly client meetings.
* Track project risks, issues, decisions, and action items.
* Coordinate work across interconnected research tasks with overlapping timelines.
* Maintain communication with government stakeholders.
* Monitor deliverable quality and submission deadlines.
* Support preparation of research reports, presentations, and other project products.
* Work with the Lead Analyst to ensure research activities remain aligned with project objectives.


The Government will assess project management based in part on timely deliverables, task coordination, responsiveness, and continuity of key personnel.

### **Minimum Qualifications**


Candidates must meet **one** of the following education and experience paths:

* Master’s degree in a field related to social science or statistics from an accredited institution; **or**
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution plus an additional three years of related experience above the minimum experience requirement.


Candidates must also have:

* At least **5 years of professional experience managing fast\-paced research projects**.
* Experience managing **social science research**.
* Experience coordinating projects with multiple or overlapping tasks.
* Experience establishing clear communication and tracking project risks.
* Ability to work with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


Federal, state, local government, nonprofit, or private\-sector research experience is relevant to the Government's evaluation.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing federally funded research or evaluation projects.
* Experience with workforce, labor, human resources, or employee retention research.
* Experience working with quantitative researchers or statisticians.
* Experience translating research activities and findings for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing federal contract deliverables.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Quality Assurance Specialist** to join our software development team and help us deliver reliable, high\-quality software products.

In this role, you will work closely with developers, product managers, and other team members throughout the entire development lifecycle. You will be responsible for identifying issues, improving testing processes, and making sure our products meet both functional and user expectations.

We are looking for someone who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and genuinely passionate about software quality.

What You'll Do

* Design, create, and execute test cases and test scenarios
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing
* Identify, document, and track bugs and inconsistencies
* Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve issues
* Review product requirements and provide feedback from a QA perspective
* Contribute to improving QA processes, standards, and best practices
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and other Agile ceremonies
* Help ensure that new features are thoroughly tested before release
* Continuously look for ways to improve product quality and testing efficiency

What We're Looking For

* Previous experience in software quality assurance or software testing
* Good understanding of software development and QA processes
* Experience with writing and executing test cases
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Attention to detail and a structured approach to work
* Ability to clearly communicate issues and collaborate with developers
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Good written and spoken English

Nice to Have

* Experience with API testing
* Experience with tools such as Postman, Jira, TestRail, or similar
* Basic understanding of SQL and databases
* Experience with automated testing
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
* Experience working in a software development environment

What We Offer

* A collaborative and supportive engineering team
* Opportunity to work on interesting and challenging software projects
* A culture that values quality, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Flexible working arrangements
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* Competitive salary and benefits
* A chance to have a real impact on the products we build

Join Us

If you are passionate about software quality and enjoy finding ways to make products better, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $15\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Parental leave

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: REMOTE Instructional Designer (Contract)
jobs.description:
**REMOTE Instructional Designer (Contract)**

**CapeTalent** isn't your average staffing agency. We connect AI\-forward Learning \& Development professionals with Fortune 100 companies who are shaping the future.


**CONTRACT DETAILS**

**1099 or C2C (No W2\)**

* 6\-month contract (strong likelihood of extension)
* 100% Remote (U.S. or Canadian candidates only)
* Start date: September 2026
* 40 hours per week @ $50–$60/hour (C2C or 1099\), based on experience
* Standard U.S. business hours (EST/CST/MST/PST)
* Heavy Slack collaboration \+ Laptop provided
* **Portfolio** **REQUIRED**

**THE ROLE**

This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role. We're looking for a Instructional Designer who designs and builds in equal measure, and who does their best work when the pace is quick and the problems are loosely defined. You'll own complete learning journeys end to end — not one\-off courses — translating dense FinTech and SaaS product workflows into experiences that feel simple, hold attention, and scale across a global audience.


The work covers both net\-new builds and reimagined legacy content, and leans on the modern toolkit: branching scenarios, simulations, persona\-led microlearning, gamified interactions, and reusable design systems. Day to day, you'll work alongside fellow designers, developers, program managers, SMEs, and product and technical partners, and you'll be the one bringing order and creative momentum when the brief is still taking shape.


**How we build matters here.** Production runs on a structured, AI\-assisted workflow with Claude embedded at the points where it saves the most time — shaping outlines and design packages, drafting content, and populating build files. We work in Claude Projects and Claude Cowork, with approved prompts, shared context, and version history living alongside the build so nothing gets lost between sessions. The intent isn't to replace your craft; it's to clear the repetitive work so your energy goes to design decisions, learning science, and iteration. Every AI output is a first draft, not a deliverable — you drive the judgment, the review, and the polish.


**What You'll Do**

* Build full learning journeys tied to real workflows and the performance outcomes they're meant to move.
* Produce storyboards and learning flows clear enough that development can run smoothly and at scale.
* Take tired legacy material and rebuild it into something visual, current, and genuinely learner\-first.
* Grow the shared toolkit — design systems, frameworks, prompt libraries, and reusable models others can build on.
* Craft interactive facilitator\-led and live virtual sessions, complete with participant materials and facilitation guides.
* Build persona\-driven microlearning, simulations, and game mechanics that lift engagement and retention.
* Use Articulate Storyline as the home base for builds — with AI feedback and interactions living inside the course itself — and design in Rise where clean, rapid development matters.
* Weave in video, animation, and other media so the finished experience feels cohesive and polished.
* Rework existing templates for better flow and engagement — nothing ships straight out of the box.
* Keep everything compliant, tracked, and QA'd in Docebo (Learning Management System).
* Work inside our AI\-assisted build workflow — using Claude, Claude Cowork, Gemini, and NotebookLM to accelerate outlining, drafting, content development, prototyping, file population, and revision cycles, with human review at every gate.
* Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with SMEs to keep learning anchored to business goals and metrics.
* Juggle several projects at once without losing speed, quality, or deadlines — and without needing much oversight.
Operate comfortably against SLAs and clear milestone gates (storyboard development QA* sign\-off).
**What We're Looking For**

* At least 5 years designing and developing instructional content, backed by a portfolio of end\-to\-end journeys, scenario work, and impact you can point to. We weigh the quality and speed of your work over length of experience.
* **You already build with generative AI in live production** — Claude (including Claude Cowork and Projects), Gemini, NotebookLM. It's woven into how we work, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Practical prompting skill: you know how to give a model the right source material and context, iterate on an output rather than accepting the first one, and tell the difference between a draft that's close and a draft that's confidently wrong.
* Fast and assured in Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) and 7Taps, plus Figma or a comparable tool for quick prototyping and storyboarding.
* Comfortable in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Audition) to create and integrate multimedia.
* Enough fluency with JavaScript and Storyline web objects to know how they stretch what a course can do.
* A track record building interactive, facilitator\-led and live virtual sessions that are engaging, scalable, and outcomes\-driven.
* A reputation for shipping strong work quickly when volume is high.
* Skilled at turning complicated systems into learning that changes performance.
* Background designing for customer\-facing teams or product training.
* Evidence that your work moves the needle on adoption, engagement, and time\-to\-proficiency (completion, NPS, practical assessment results, etc.).
* Experience creating reusable, scalable content, templates, and frameworks.
* Grounded in learning science — cognitive load, Bloom's, the forgetting curve and spaced reinforcement, behavior change and motivation, and microlearning/chunking.
* At home in Agile and fast\-paced settings.
**Why This Role?**

* You get a kick out of making complex products feel simple and engaging to learn.
* You want a seat in high\-impact FinTech/SaaS enterprise product training.
* You like roles that mix strategy with hands\-on building.
* You do your best work in modern, fast\-moving learning environment
